conclusion: S12T is the single mutant with the highest measured fitness among the 20 variants measured, with fitness +0.513.
The top measured beneficial variants are S12T +0.513, S12A +0.467, R2S +0.435, I41L +0.313, T17V +0.289; position 12 (Ser) is the measured hotspot for beneficial substitutions.

ESM-2 cross-position scores are not a reliable fitness ranker: Spearman(ESM-2, measured fitness)=+0.009 over 20 measured variants, and the highest-scoring variant H40K (+2.039) measured the worst (-0.578). ESM-2 magnitude should not be trusted across positions; within a position it had some ordering value (S12).
Hypothesis H0 (ESM-2 ranks fitness) is partially falsified and was revised: use ESM-2 only to rank substitutions within a position already shown beneficial by measurement.

UNCERTAINTY/LIMITATION: only 20 of 834 candidates were measured and both the oracle (20/20) and model (100/100) budgets are exhausted. The global maximum over all 834 candidates is UNOBSERVED; the true max could be an unmeasured variant, most plausibly another position-12 substitution (e.g. S12C/S12V) or an unmeasured substitution at positions 2/41/17. S12T is therefore the best-evidenced candidate, not a proven global maximum.
